## Scope Check

- [ ] This does not add fake framework behavior before the runtime architecture is ready.
- [ ] This avoids unnecessary dependencies or explains why a dependency is needed.
- [ ] This is compatible with the runtime-first architecture.
- [ ] This needs an RFC, or the reason it does not need one is clear.
